name: gscindex-vendor-effects
description: Build-time only workspace. Vendors three npm-distributed React effect packages (thinking-orbs, border-beam, metal-fx) into framework-free browser bundles / static CSS consumed by the Python Dash app's assets/ folder. Nothing here ships to the browser as-is — `npm run build` regenerates assets/vendor/*.js and assets/vendor/border-beam-pulse.css, which ARE committed to git (the Dash app has no client build step in production).

scripts.build: node scripts/build-thinking-orbs.mjs && node scripts/build-metal-fx.mjs && node scripts/generate-border-beam-css.mjs
